headline: Mass surveillance and self-sufficiency: How China's leadership is reviving Mao's old principles
description: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (5/7). In 1963, Mao Zedong made the village of Fengqiao an example of how to encourage mass mobilization and resolve conflicts locally. Under Xi Jinping, the experiment has evolved into a system ensuring Beijing's absolute control.

headline: Poll: Le Pen begins presidential campaign in strongest position ever amid worried, angry electorate
